definitions.full: H1920. hadaph הָדַף verb thrust , .push, drive ( הֲדַף in ᵑ7 ; Arabic is ingressus ad aliquem fuit, propinquus fuit , also of time prope accessit ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular suffix הֲדָפוֺ Num 35:22 ; Jer 46:15 ; 1 singular suffix וַהֲדַפְתִּיךָ consecutive Isa 22:19 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יֶהְדֹּף Prov 10:3 ; suffix 3masculine singular יֶהְדֳּפֶנּוּ Num 35:20 ; suffix 3masculine plural יֶהְדֳּפֵם Josh 23:5 ; 3 masculine plural suffix יֶהְדְּפֻהוּ Job 18:18 ; 2 masculine plural תֶּהְדֹּ֑פוּ Ezek 34:21 ; Infinitive הֲדֹף Deut 6:19 ; 9:4 ; suffix הָדְפָהּ 2Kin 4:27 ; — 1 thrust, push , subject man, followed by accusative Num 35:20 , 22 (here fatally); subject cattle, figurative of men, Ezek 34:21 (instrumental בְּכָתֵף ; || נָגַח ); push away 2Kin 4:27 (Gehazi, the Shunammite); thrust away (from oneself) figurative = reject , רְשָׁעִים הַוַּת Prov 10:3 (subject ׳י ). 2 thrust out, drive out , followed by מִן of place whence & accusative of person; of ׳י driving out enemies of Israel from Canaan Deut 6:19 ; 9:4 ; Josh 23:5 ; compare also indefinite subject אֶלחֿשֶׁךְ מֵאוֺר יֶהְדְּפֻהוּ Job 18:18 (|| יְנִדֻּהוּ וּמִתֵּבֵל ); & Jer 46:15 (where no plural whence). Hence 3 = depose Isa 22:19 of ׳י deposing Shebna (followed by מִן of station).
